column1: #mapping_set_description: Template. Mappings from the library lending module to another vocabulary, one row per mapping, each with its justification and the role that made it. Replace the example prefixes and rows with your own.

column9: Both name one agreement for one copy until a due date.
The other vocabulary also counts a staff-initiated extension; ours is at the member's request.
Library services also covers reference and events; circulation is the lending part of it.
